<documents>
<document id="card-replacement-basic">
CardˆreplacementˆfeesˆonˆBasicˆThisˆisˆwhatˆaˆreplacementˆcardˆcostsˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan,ˆwhetherˆit'sˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged.ˆ|ˆ|ˆCostˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆReplacementˆcardˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆStandardˆshippingˆ(7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆ(2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays)ˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆOnˆBasic,ˆifˆyouˆchooseˆexpeditedˆshippingˆyouˆpayˆbothˆtheˆreplacementˆfeeˆandˆtheˆshippingˆfee.ˆStandardˆshippingˆonlyˆcostsˆtheˆreplacementˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆdon'tˆchargeˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆwhenˆaˆcardˆisˆlostˆinˆtheˆmail,ˆwhenˆweˆreplaceˆaˆcardˆbecauseˆofˆaˆproblemˆonˆourˆside,ˆorˆforˆyourˆautomaticˆrenewalˆcard.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆorderˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆReplaceˆcard.ˆPickˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamaged,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆshippingˆspeed.ˆFeesˆareˆchargedˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆyouˆplaceˆtheˆorder.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆforˆyouˆinˆtheˆappˆchat.ˆTheˆsameˆfeesˆapplyˆeitherˆway.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-damaged">
ReplacingˆaˆdamagedˆcardˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆcracked,ˆbent,ˆorˆtheˆchipˆorˆcontactlessˆstopsˆworking,ˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆorderˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆReplaceˆcard,ˆthenˆDamaged.ˆConfirmˆyourˆaddressˆandˆpickˆaˆshippingˆspeed.ˆ##ˆYourˆoldˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆWhenˆyouˆreportˆaˆcardˆasˆdamaged,ˆweˆdon'tˆcancelˆit.ˆYouˆcanˆkeepˆusingˆitˆ(ifˆitˆstillˆworks)ˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆreplacement.ˆActivatingˆtheˆnewˆcardˆswitchesˆtheˆoldˆoneˆoff.ˆTheˆnewˆcardˆhasˆtheˆsameˆcardˆnumber,ˆaˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆaˆnewˆsecurityˆcode.ˆMerchantsˆthatˆstoreˆyourˆcardˆmayˆneedˆtheˆnewˆexpiryˆdate.ˆ##ˆCostˆandˆshippingˆTheˆreplacementˆfeeˆisˆtheˆsameˆasˆforˆaˆlostˆcard:ˆ$5.00ˆonˆBasicˆandˆfreeˆonˆPlusˆandˆPremium.ˆStandardˆshippingˆtakesˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆandˆcostsˆ$25.00ˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus.ˆIt'sˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆIfˆyou'reˆnotˆsureˆwhetherˆtheˆcardˆisˆdamagedˆorˆlost,ˆfreezeˆitˆfirst.ˆYouˆcanˆdecideˆafterward.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: I lost my card and I'm on Basic. How much is a replacement and how long with normal shipping?
